context: Evaluates whether the agent detects an allowlisted-but-unregistered MCP server and reports it as a distinct phantom-tool finding, connecting it to a rule file that mandates the same unresolvable tool, rather than folding it into redundancy or staleness findings. Covers Workflow step 4's phantom-tool and rule-mandate checks.

checklist.name: Phantom mismatch identified
checklist.description: ghostqueue is identified as allowlisted in permissions but not registered in either .mcp.json

checklist.name: Named as phantom-tool finding
checklist.description: The finding is presented as its own phantom-tool category, not a generic misconfiguration note

checklist.name: Rule-mandate connection made
checklist.description: The response connects the finding to the rule file that mandates mcp__ghostqueue__enqueue

checklist.name: Unenforceability stated
checklist.description: The response states that the rule's mandate is currently unenforceable because the tool is not wired anywhere

checklist.name: Not conflated with redundancy
checklist.description: The finding is not presented as a pick-one redundancy, since there is no cardinality conflict here

checklist.name: Not conflated with staleness
checklist.description: The finding is not presented as a watch/dormant staleness note, which is a different signal

checklist.name: codelantern not misflagged
checklist.description: codelantern, which is both allowlisted and registered, is not incorrectly flagged as phantom

checklist.name: No silent remediation
checklist.description: The agent does not register a ghostqueue server or remove the permission entry in this turn
